specialRules.ruleFull: Warriors within 6" of the Chief may use his Leadership instead of their own.
The Friar is a Priest of Taal and prays from the Prayers of Taal.
A Bowman ignores cover penalties when he shoots a bow or a long bow.

A Trapper may set a trap in a turn he does nothing else, and not in one in which he recovered from being knocked down: place a marker touching him. A model, friend or foe, that moves within 2" of the marker rolls a D6, and on a 3+ triggers the trap and takes a Strength 4 hit; the Trapper never triggers his own. If the hit doesn't wound or the trap isn't triggered, the model may finish its move; a model knocked down or stunned is placed 2" from the marker. The marker is removed either way.

fighters.name: Hunting Hound
fighters.equipment: None. Hunting Hounds use no weapons or equipment.

specialRules.ruleFull: Hunting Hounds are animals and gain no experience.

A warband may buy no more Hunting Hounds than it has Trappers. While it has more Hounds than Trappers, the spare Hounds may not fight; they may be kept until the Trappers are replaced, and still count towards the warband size for trading and for the maximum.

specialSkillsList.name: Staff Master
specialSkillsList.description: While he fights with a quarter staff the warrior may use it to parry every attack one opponent makes.

specialSkillsList.name: Forager
specialSkillsList.description: The warrior doesn't count towards the warband's size when its income is worked out.

flags.what: A Woodsmen warband needs at least 3 models: our templates hold no minimum, so it is not imported. No henchmen group sizes and no maximum profiles are printed, so the warband takes our Human race.
The skill table: the Chief ticks every column, the Friar Combat, Academic, Strength, Speed and Special, the Hunter Combat, Shooting, Speed and Special, and the Cub Combat, Shooting and Special.

The special skills: Bull Rush and Infiltration are ours, the same effects (ours name the Ostlanders). The PDF's Sniper is our Sniper (Shadow Warriors), both clauses the same; our other skill named Sniper lacks the spotting test and bars black powder weapons. Staff Master and Forager are new. A decision for William.

The Quarterstaff entry (15 gc, Common; Close Combat, As User +1, Two Handed and Parry) is its own item, Quarter Staff (Woodsmen de Artois), named for the warband (William, 11 Nov 2026), shown under the list's name. Our Quarter Staff is As user with Balanced, Parry and Freestyle, a different weapon, and is left unchanged.
The list's Throwing Knife (15 gc) is our Throwing Knives/Stars.
The Friar's rule is headed "Wizard" but reads "The Friar is a Priest of Taal and may use the prayers of Taal in TC 11": he is read as a priest of the Prayers of Taal.
The Hunting Hound's profile row is labelled "Trapper": read as the Hound's, the entry it sits under.
Hunting Hounds are "0-5" in their entry, while Choice of Warriors says no more Hunting Hounds than Trappers: the count is 0-5 and the limit is his Dog Handler rule.
The Trapper's Set Traps rule is the same mechanic as our Set Traps skill (Gnoblars only), and is kept as his own rule, as the PDF prints it.
